spec.description:
Proctor Q-Silence P is an acoustic underlay and isolation
membrane engineered for impact noise reduction beneath screeds, floating timber,
and tile flooring systems. Fabricated from high-density elastomeric and
resilient acoustic polymer compounds, it decouples the finished floor from the
structural subfloor to limit footstep and structural vibration transmission. It
assists multi-residential apartments and commercial developments in meeting
National Construction Code (NCC) acoustic impact sound performance standards.
features:
High-performance acoustic isolation reducing footstep impact
noise

Decouples floor finishes from concrete and timber structural
subfloors

Engineered for installation under screeds, engineered timber, and
tiles

Resilient elastomeric polymer structure maintains cushioning under
heavy loads
Resists compression creep over the building life cycle

Water
and rot resistant; will not degrade in damp construction conditions

Fast,
roll-out installation with minimal floor buildup height

Assists in complying
with NCC Part F5 impact sound ratings
spec.fire:
Tested for low early fire hazard
properties in flooring assemblies
spec.compliance:
NCC Volume One (Part F5 /
Specification 28) impact sound ratings, ISO 717-2
spec.sustainability: Recyclable synthetic polymer, zero ODP, non-hazardous
install:
Ensure
structural concrete slab or timber subfloor is level, clean, and dry

Repair
subfloor cracks and remove protrusions before laying underlay

Roll out
Q-Silence P membrane across the floor area, butting edges tightly

Run
acoustic isolation strips up the perimeter walls to isolate the floor finish
from skirting

Tape all adjoining underlay seams with waterproof tape to
prevent screed slurry bridging

Pour screed or install floor overlay directly
over the membrane according to flooring specification

Trim excess perimeter
isolation strips flush after flooring is completed
selection_checklist:
Confirm floor finish type (sand-cement screed, engineered timber, laminate, or
tiles)

Verify target acoustic impact rating (L'nT,w target from acoustic
consultant)

Ensure perimeter isolation strips are included to eliminate
acoustic flanking
Calculate total floor area including waste allowance
limitations:
Subfloor must be
within allowable flatness tolerances prior to installation

Do not
mechanically fix through the membrane as screws create acoustic bridges

Must
be isolated from perimeter walls and skirtings
spec.warranty:
Backed by
Proctor Group Australia product warranty

problem_keywords:
hard flooring failing strata acoustic
rules
use_cases:
Acoustic impact sound isolation under sand-cement screeds in multi-residential
apartments

Decoupling engineered timber and laminate flooring over concrete
slabs to satisfy strata by-laws

Vibration and impact damping in commercial
and institutional floor-ceiling assemblies
not_for:
Direct exposure to heavy wheeled
traffic without floor finish

Proctor Q-Silence P is an
acoustic underlay and isolation membrane designed to reduce impact sound
transmission (L'nT,w) beneath screeds, floating timber, and tile flooring
systems. Constructed from resilient elastomeric polymer composites, it decouples
floor finishes from concrete slabs and timber subfloors, preventing footstep
